payload.author: claude
payload.body: Shipped latency suite in @fricken/bench (bench/src/latency.ts) on branch feat/fr97-98-benchmarks. runLatency / pnpm bench:latency measures p50/p90/p99 across HTTP request, WS append->ack round-trip, object-upsert->delta fan-out, catch-up (subscribe->StreamPage over a seeded backlog), and reconnect. Reuses the FR-96 harness's summarizeLatency + a new shared server-spin-up helper (bench/src/server-target.ts). Emits machine-readable JSON (tool: frick-latency-bench). Covered by apps/server/tests/bench-suites.test.ts (tiny end-to-end, asserts shape). Gate green: typecheck exit 0; server vitest 843 passed | 45 skipped.
